end.parentNote: Asha practised sorting examples into observation, hypothesis, law and theory, and Tara explained why repeated 9.8 m/s² supports calling gravity a law. Tara also explored a hypothesis about curd setting in warmth and identified camouflage in animals. Tara asked for a break and a new topic when they felt bored; at home, you can play a quick “observation or hypothesis?” sorting game using everyday examples.
